notes: Nubo 1.4 home uses icon resource-ids. Milk, sleep, and pump are timers: tap to start, wait, tap to stop so the session is finished. Bottle, pee, and poop are one-tap logs. Formula-per-click 90 is not 482 mL. Nursing timeout 45 is not 777 minutes. No gender field. Skip hardware pairing. force_stop so a leftover Notes screen does not hide home buttons. After home events, open NoteActivity, fill title and body (body tap uses the top of the tall field so the keyboard does not eat the tap), hide the IME, then Save.
